ringBefore.line: 💡 Maypop: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🤒 Catalina is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile east caught a Gray Squirrel! About 350 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.
— DAY 167 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Hickory Nuts (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
Catalina kneels and asks. The land answers: 7 bellies full in Haven today. (Feed the Multitude)
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
The water bulges. Something big just decided you might be food.
